title: Rick's RPG loot
description: Adds varied stats to default loot table equipment and adds vanilla friendly "Legendary Items" found in rare gameplay scenarios.
body:
# Rick's RPG Loot
A lightweight datapack that adds varied stats to default loot table equipment and adds vanilla friendly "Legendary Items" found in rare gameplay scenarios.

These simple changes should encourage players to seek out structures in search of optimal stat combinations for better gear, as well as combine different teirs of armor late into gameplay for teir specific perks. the goal is to keep exploration interesting beyond just visiting a structure once.

This pack is compatible with any pack which relies on vanilla loot tables and attempts not to add anything outside the scope of vanilla attributes and effects.

(for an optimal experience including custom textures "Rick's default" resource pack is reccomended)
